prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the mortgage-underwriting agent (residential mortgage applications and remortgages) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: an arrears payment plan. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …"). Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 2)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"When an arrears payment plan is in place, check whether the regular instalment and the arrears contribution are both affordable on the verified income, because a plan that only just clears today’s shortfall can still fail at underwriting if the budget is stretched."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the plan has been running for a sensible period with every payment made on time, treat that as evidence of improving conduct, but still confirm the original cause of arrears has been resolved before relying on it."},{"type":"observation","content":"When the arrears plan is recent, be careful not to assume stability too quickly; I look for at least a few consistent payments and no fresh missed instalments before I give it much weight."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the account is on a formal arrears arrangement, always distinguish between a one-off catch-up and a structured plan, because the latter usually means there is an ongoing affordability issue rather than a temporary timing problem."},{"type":"preference","content":"When a borrower can show the arrears arose from a short-term event and the plan has been kept exactly as agreed, I prefer to focus on current conduct rather than over-penalising historical missed payments."},{"type":"observation","content":"When there are multiple credit commitments as well as an arrears plan, I test the whole monthly outgoings picture together, since the plan may look manageable in isolation but still leave too little headroom overall."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the arrears payment plan ends before completion, treat that as a warning sign and check the lender’s current status carefully, because incomplete plans can indicate the borrower is still under financial pressure."},{"type":"observation","content":"When assessing a remortgage, I pay close attention to whether the new deal actually reduces the monthly payment enough to make the arrears plan realistic, as a small saving may not be enough to change the risk."},{"type":"preference","content":"When the arrears plan was agreed because of a change in income that has now been reversed, I prefer to see recent payslips or other evidence of recovery rather than rely on verbal reassurance alone."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the plan involves extra payments over and above the normal mortgage instalment, the extra amount must be treated as a committed expense for affordability purposes until the arrears are cleared."}]}
